name: StatusBar
summary: Decorative mobile-platform status-bar row. Renders time on the left, carrier / signal / wifi / battery cluster on the right, sized and styled for the iOS island, iOS notch, or Android pin-hole platform. Companion to PhoneFrame.

tone.description: auto: text colored to contrast with the underlying canvas. Set explicitly when the canvas is an image and the system can't infer.

battery.description: 0-100. Render a battery glyph at that percentage.

rules: StatusBar is decorative inside a PhoneFrame — aria-hidden=true.
When mounted as a real status bar (PWA full-screen), it MUST not steal focus.

do: Use 9:41 as the default time — the established Apple keynote convention.
Battery glyph is filled in tone='auto' contrast.
Use mono digits with .lumen-tnum so the time stays steady.
dont: Don't render brand-name carriers in production marketing — use 'Carrier' as a neutral fallback.
Don't render a fake low-battery state next to a 'Plug in' Banner — that's misleading.
